verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's guidance pages state some pre-filing requirements up front, but only for annual-report e-filing. They list accepted payment methods, including an optional prepaid Sunbiz E-File Account, and say a typed name satisfies the signature requirement under s.15.16, F.S. Nothing documents whether an account, login, or identity-proofing step is needed before formation filings. missing for 10: an explicit statement of account/registration requirements before filing, any disclosure of credential or identity-verification steps (or confirmation that none exist), coverage of the LLC/corporation formation flows rather than just annual reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the actual flow.
